subject.title: feat(google): add Google Vertex AI provider with ADC auth and global endpoint routing

question: Should maintainers salvage any unique Google Vertex code from this broad provider-split branch, or use the active onboarding/setup PR as the landing path for the remaining work?
rationale: The branch overlaps shipped ADC/routing fixes and an active proof-supplied follow-up, but choosing whether a distinct google-vertex provider split should exist is a product and compatibility decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Salvage narrowly
options.body: Rebase only any still-useful service-account or thought-signature handling onto current main, preserve metadata-server and external_account ADC, and drop unrelated oc-path churn before review.

options.title: Use the active onboarding path
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/87800 as the setup/onboarding candidate while this broader provider split remains paused.

options.title: Retire after pair review
options.body: Close this PR only after the paired same-author issue and active follow-up are explicitly resolved or superseded.

recommendation.title: Salvage narrowly
recommendation.body: Rebase only any still-useful service-account or thought-signature handling onto current main, preserve metadata-server and external_account ADC, and drop unrelated oc-path churn before review.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged production ADC work is the current-main behavior most at risk from this branch's auth changes.
